packageRules.description: Pin python to 3.13 until aider-chat and other adapters confirm 3.14 compatibility.
Hold major updates back longer so a fast-follow patch can land before we bump.

Hold TypeScript on 6.x for the npm packages: ts-jest's peer range is '>=4.3 <7', so a TypeScript 7 bump makes 'npm ci' fail with ERESOLVE. Renovate updates package.json and the lockfile together, so a bump within this range stays consistent. Lift this once ts-jest supports TypeScript 7.
